name: agent-skillguard
description: Scan agent skills locally for reviewable risk patterns before installation.

interface.longDescription: Agent SkillGuard performs deterministic local pre-install inspection of agent skills. It reports matched versioned rules, bounded evidence, remediation, and explicit non-coverage without executing, installing, enabling, certifying, or uploading the target.
defaultPrompt: Scan this skill before I install it.
Explain every flagged pattern and its evidence.
Compare this package against the public fixture corpus.
